articulation.label: wet
articulation.alt: wet: /w/ → /ɛ/ → /t/. Tongue, lips, contact and airflow positions.
notes: /w/: Round the lips; raise the back of the tongue.
/ɛ/: Front tongue; open the jaw a little more.
/t/: Tongue tip touches the ridge, then releases.
articulation.note: Join the sounds smoothly after practising each position.

cards.title: Read and write
sections: Puck does the laundry on Saturday. He puts the dirty towels in the washing machine and hangs the clean shirts on the clothesline. While they dry, he goes swimming. After his swim, he dries off with a clean towel. Later, he folds the dry shirts and puts them away.
What does Puck do with the shirts before and after they dry?
Write two sentences using two words from today’s new word bank.
